title: 19 non-negotiable demands to change the Dark Skies pilot, and NBC's Don Ohlmeyer steps in

tellings.quote: a list of 19 non-negotiable demands of things that had to change in our pilot.

plain: In 1996, the makers of Dark Skies, a television series about a hidden alien presence, were handed "a list of 19 non-negotiable demands" for changes to their first episode before Don Ohlmeyer, a senior executive at the NBC network, stepped in. The television writer Bryce Zabel, who made the show with a writer named Brent Friedman, tells this from his own experience, in a talk that also touches on the filmmaker Steven Spielberg, as part of a story about how much control others had over a UFO drama on network TV.
